results.text: Cardiac arrest due to airway obstruction in Angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitor-induced angioedema. Angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitor-induced angioedema is a rare but serious side effect of angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitors (ACEi). It causes bradykinin accumulation, leading to the swelling of various tissus, including upper airway. results.text: Fludarabine-induced bradycardia in allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation: A retrospective study.
